capabilities: Run interactive Bash sessions in Obsidian tabs
Manage the PTY, shell, and process lifecycle through a local Rust bridge
Install and operate the bridge as a Termux runit service
Authenticate connections with an expiring local token
Start shells with a ~/.obsidianrc-only startup file
disambiguation: Not an SSH client, remote shell server, or code-server replacement; the bridge runs locally on the device and binds to 127.0.0.1 only.
extras: Requires native Termux on aarch64 and a hardware keyboard for the supported workflow; installation is only possible after the first GitHub Release is published, and connection tokens expire after six months.
problem: Obsidian on Android offers no way to run a real local shell session inside an app tab.

relations.evidence: Use a real native Termux shell inside Obsidian on Android.

summary: Interactive native Termux terminal inside Obsidian on Android, with a local Rust bridge that owns the PTY, shell, and process lifecycle.
